subject.title: Feature: Respect userTimezone in memory file timestamps and naming

question: Should bundled session-memory filenames and `# Session` headers use `agents.defaults.userTimezone` when it differs from the gateway host timezone?
rationale: Current docs and shipped behavior say host-local, while auto-flush already follows `userTimezone`; changing this affects visible memory filenames and headers for existing users.

options.title: Adopt `userTimezone` for session-memory
options.body: Make session-memory artifacts match the system prompt and auto-flush configured-timezone behavior, with focused tests for host/user timezone divergence.

options.title: Keep host-local session-memory
options.body: Leave current shipped filenames and headers intact and document that only auto-flush uses `userTimezone` today.

options.title: Add a dedicated memory timezone setting
options.body: Introduce a new explicit memory-artifact timezone contract, but only after maintainers accept the added config surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt `userTimezone` for session-memory
recommendation.body: Make session-memory artifacts match the system prompt and auto-flush configured-timezone behavior, with focused tests for host/user timezone divergence.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged and recently maintained the current session-memory hook behavior that the product decision would change.
